20 min to 2 h per task; the server takes weeks to unlock all the stages

An island full of nightmare creatures was discovered by the Inquisition. This quest is a set of tasks in Roshamuul that advance a **permanent world change** of the server: first the bridge of Lower Roshamuul is rebuilt, then the wall of Guzzlemaw Valley is torn down and finally {creature:Gaz'haragoth} is killed in Upper Roshamuul. Along the way you earn Inquisition Gold, {item:Essence of Dread|Essences of Dread}, {item:Cluster of Solace|Clusters of Solace} and {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking|Essences of Wishful Thinking}, which are used to craft and upgrade {wiki:Umbral Items|Umbral Items}.
Nightmare creatures lurk on an island recently discovered by the Inquisition...

By doing the missions *A Cup of Tea*, *Ancient Dreams* and *Waters of Life* (from {npc:Morax}) and *Mend What's Broken* (from {npc:Dream Butterfly}).
You don't need to request the "find things on the ground" tasks: you are automatically put on the mission when you interact with the objects.
At Dream Butterfly you can accept **all** the tasks at once — that is the recommended way.
Kills made before you request a kill task count all the same; requesting the task just gives you the counter in the Quest Log.
Server stages only change at {wiki:Server Save}. On low-population servers it can take weeks.
Keep any leftover Dream Sand and the {item:Strange Good Night Songs}: on the Soothing Bad Dreams repeat you save half the work.
1. Getting to Roshamuul and understanding the stages
This quest is a permanent world change with 4 stages. Each player contributes with tasks; when the server does enough, it unlocks the next zone at the next Server Save.
